description: The reproducible-build identity of every contract the proof's S8 statement relies on (the anchor, its verifier and the generated Groth16 verifier it calls, the account factory, the account runtime, the outcome registry): per build the masked-runtime keccak, the immutables with offsets and the rule each value must satisfy, the compiler settings and the storage slots of every authorization-deciding variable; per chain the live addresses that were byte-compared to those builds, and the real accounts compared too. Re-derive with scripts/verify-identity-manifest.sh.

source.note: builds use the default foundry profile with auto-detected remappings switched off and the remapping set of the named variant, so they do not depend on whether nested submodules are initialised

maskRule: Zero every [start, start+length) range listed in a build's immutables[].references in the runtime code (eth_getCode), then keccak256. The CBOR metadata trailer is part of the hashed bytes and must match exactly.

manifestHash.over: the bytes of identity-manifest.json with CRLF normalised to LF

r5.note: default profile, 5 remappings: every contract deployed from 2026-10-02 on, incl. Adiri greenfield (non-recursive submodules)

r7.note: default profile, 7 remappings: the May-2026 environment (nested OpenZeppelin submodules initialised) the generated Groth16 verifiers on 11155111/84532/421614 were built in

policy.description: The values a verifier requires of the pinned contracts, read from the four chains at generation and held to the constants declared in scripts/lib/declared.mjs (V2_SPEC_S8 r3). owner is a per-chain history; txScan lists the transaction types the rule-IB census treats as covered or as system types (no sender rule); rules are the policy rules judged at the attestation block; setRootHistory carries the registry state (root, threshold, keysDigest, the exact authorized-commitment set) that lets a verifier prove the registry without an S9 registry.
